title: GrowthBook carousel track
description: A swipeable horizontal row of slides that snaps to each card, with an optional slow autoplay that pauses on hover, optional round arrow buttons, and optional dimming of the slides that aren't in front.
notes: native scroll-snap: works without JavaScript (swipe / shift-scroll); JavaScript adds autoplay, arrows and dimming
autoplay is off under reduced motion and while the pointer or focus is inside
name: growthbook-track

props.name: slideClassName
props.description: width of each slide, e.g. "w-[18.75rem] lg:w-[25rem]"

props.name: autoplay
props.description: move to the next slide every n milliseconds (wraps to the first at the end)

props.name: dimInactive
props.description: slides other than the front one fade to 45%

props.name: prevLabel
props.description: labels for the round previous / next buttons; the buttons show only when both are set

props.name: arrowsClassName
props.description: classes for the arrow row (e.g. alignment, margin)

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: classes for the scrolling row itself (gap, padding)
